name: Box
description: Places content on a chosen plane with optional borders, corners and inset spacing.

children.description: Content to render inside the box

plane.description: The plane the box paints: canvas (page floor), band (recessed strip), surface (card plane) or raised (lifted plane). Omit for a transparent box.

border.description: The one hairline: true on every side, or a single logical block side.

radius.description: Corner role. nested is the concentric corner for a box inset inside a surface.

inset.description: Inner inset from the surface inset recipe: compact (12) or default (16).

className.description: Additional class; use it for one-off sizing

when: Putting a region on a named plane: canvas, band, surface or raised
A hairline-separated strip or a bordered region without Card's header and footer
Rendering a semantic element with the surface inset
whenNot: Spacing a row or column of siblings (use Stack)
Lifting a box with a shadow: only floating surfaces cast shadow
guidelines: Pick the plane by role, never by colour: canvas is the page floor, band a recessed strip, surface the card plane, raised a lifted plane
Use radius="nested" for a box inside a surface so the corners stay concentric
Parent owns spacing: put Boxes in a Stack with a gap instead of adding margins
Size a Box with className when it must be fixed; the props carry no raw dimensions
accessibility: Choose a semantic as value (section, aside, nav) for landmark regions
A plane is decoration: never let it carry meaning on its own

examples.name: Band
examples.description: A recessed strip on the band plane with the compact inset.
examples.code:
<Box plane="band" radius="control" inset="compact">
  Recessed strip on the band plane
</Box>

examples.name: Surface
examples.description: A bordered region on the surface plane.
examples.code:
<Box plane="surface" border radius="surface" inset="default">
  Bordered region on the surface plane
</Box>

examples.name: Nested
examples.description: A band tile inside a surface keeps its corners concentric.
examples.code:
import { Box } from '@/components/Box';

<Box plane="surface" border radius="surface" inset="compact">
  <Box plane="band" radius="nested" inset="compact">
    Inner tile at the nested corner
  </Box>
</Box>

examples.name: Block Border
examples.description: A single hairline on one logical side divides two strips.

examples.name: Planes
examples.description: The four planes side by side.
examples.code:
import { Box } from '@/components/Box';
import { Stack } from '@/components/Stack';

<Box plane="canvas" inset="default">
  <Stack gap="sm">
    <Box plane="band" radius="control" inset="compact">Band</Box>
    <Box plane="surface" border radius="surface" inset="compact">Surface</Box>
    <Box plane="raised" border radius="surface" inset="compact">Raised</Box>
  </Stack>
</Box>

relations.note: Use Stack for directional layouts with gap
Use Card for content containers with structure

propsSummary: All standard HTMLElement props are forwarded to the rendered element
